rev.t: If you’re looking for authentic Bengaluru-style South Indian food, Bengaluru Cafe is a must-visit! The ambience is clean, modern, and welcoming, with quick self-service and a lively atmosphere. The food was fresh, flavorful, and served hot. …

went there for breakfast after cycling. i had benne dose and idli with filter coffee. the dose was so crunchy and juicy. idli was soft. it was delicious. i still have the essence of that place with me. must try if in bangalore
